schema.title: event name
schema.endDate: YYYY-MM-DD (last day, optional, defaults to startDate)

locations.city: one entry per location; multiple entries = multi-city or hybrid (use region "Online" for the virtual part)
locations.region: Africa | Asia | Europe | North America | South America | Oceania | Online
locations.url: optional — map link for THIS location, preferably OpenStreetMap (renders with ⌖ in the location column); venue pages belong in links[] as a "Venue" link

schema.website: the one main link to the event website

links.label: link name (CFP, Schedule, Tickets, Pre-registration, Videos)
links.startsAt: YYYY-MM-DD, optional — when this link/window opens (CFP opening, pre-registration start)
links.endsAt: YYYY-MM-DD, optional — when it closes; the site annotates open links with the closing date

schema.cfpDeadline: DEPRECATED v1 field — if present, it is merged into the CFP link endsAt
schema.status: optional: "cancelled" | "rescheduled" (moved, new date not announced — never auto-hidden until updated) | "tentative" (announced, dates not confirmed: startDate/endDate are a curator estimate, rendered with ≈ and tbc). Absent = scheduled.
schema.rescheduledFrom: optional YYYY-MM-DD — the original startDate when dates move in EITHER direction (postponed or pulled forward). Edit startDate/endDate to the new dates and set this; the site tags the row "rescheduled from <old date>"
schema.scope: optional: "track" — a broader (multi-topic) conference with a dedicated Go track/devroom; renders a ◐ go track tag and is filterable. Absent = Go-focused event.
schema.unverified: temporary flag (true): the entry was drafted without a human checking the details against a source — renders as a tiny amber ? marker; delete the field once the entry has been verified or corrected.
